properties.name: flint.application.name
properties.description: Application name. Shown in the console log format as [name].

properties.name: flint.application.group
properties.description: Application group. Shown in the console log format after the name.

properties.name: flint.application.version
properties.description: Application version, for the banner and the startup log.

properties.name: flint.main.banner-mode
properties.description: Mode used to display the banner when the application runs.

properties.name: flint.main.web-application-type
properties.description: Flag to explicitly request a specific type of web application.

properties.name: flint.main.log-startup-info
properties.description: Whether to log information about the application when it starts.

properties.name: flint.profiles.active
properties.description: Comma-separated list of active profiles. Can be overridden by a command line switch.

properties.name: flint.profiles.default
properties.description: Name of the profile to enable if no profile is active.

properties.name: flint.profiles.include
properties.description: Unconditionally activate the specified comma-separated list of profiles (or list of profiles if using YAML).

properties.name: flint.profiles.group
properties.description: Profile groups to define a logical name for a related group of profiles.

properties.name: flint.config.location
properties.description: Config file locations that replace the defaults.

properties.name: flint.config.additional-location
properties.description: Config file locations used in addition to the defaults.

properties.name: flint.config.activate.on-profile
properties.description: Profile expressions that should match for the document to be included.

properties.name: logging.level
properties.description: Log levels severity mapping. For instance, `logging.level.org.springframework=DEBUG`.
